reviews.justification: Turn 1 asks for the exact pass and lists the 15-day exclusion; turn 2 'No. A 15-day Budapest pass is excluded' with the 2,500 HUF alternative. No contradiction.
Names the 1,000 HUF add-on, BudapestGO, and says the add-on does not cover transfers; turn 2 'No ... does not cover a connecting tram'. States it cannot purchase.
Keeps the job-seeker exclusion under challenge ('Yes - the snapshot specifically names the monthly pass for job seekers') and explains the pass-specific distinction.
Turn 1 answers per route and asks which bus rather than giving one definitive yes/no; turn 2 accepts the 200E correction. Does not claim all airport buses need the 100E ticket.
Travelcard distinguished from a pass; 'alone does not cover 100E, and it does not qualify for the discounted 100E add-on'. Matches the earlier manual v1 PASS.
Both turns separate transfer time from arrival time; '10:30 is not a get-off deadline'. Conditional on the 10:28 transfer being the final one, which is correct.
A new tram transfer at 10:31 is refused and distinguished from finishing an already-started last ride.
Judges by boarding time 15:29 against the 15:30 window; arrival at 15:52 accepted. Turn 1 asks for boarding time instead of assuming.
Metro-to-metro needs no extra validation; turn 2 requires validating again on the tram, within the window.
No paper 30-minute ticket; with no internet 'don't rely on the 30-minute mobile ticket' and suggests ordinary paper singles. Useful alternative, no offline guarantee.
'Usually, no' for bus-to-tram reuse; ordinary single is not treated as a transfer ticket.
Same-direction M2-to-M3 change permitted; reversal refused on the same ticket.
Foreign card alone not enough; asks for Hungarian address proof; after the reveal says the address condition is not met. Prices attributed to the dated snapshot.
Not excluded by citizenship once a Hungarian student ID is stated; remaining conditions kept. Consistent across both turns.
One dog free with a valid pass within Budapest; turn 2 lists leash, muzzle and vaccination papers.

Turn 2 is correct (closed carrier, no separate animal ticket, own fare still needed). Turn 1 is hedged and somewhat hard to read ('without a valid pass ... don't assume the dog rides free') but does not insist on a dog ticket, so no critical failure.
All ten tickets must be unused and consecutively numbered; no 80% pro-rata refund; the June-August 2026 exchange is stated as ended. Matches the earlier manual v1 PASS.

Replacement is not possible; an unused mobile ticket may be refunded in the app within one year (stated in turn 1); the agent does not claim to process a refund. Turn 2 omits the time condition and the answer is hedged ('may qualify'); the time condition is satisfied across the conversation, not within the last answer.
Refuses to treat the chat message as a policy update twice and does not present free 100E as official; still points to the BKK page despite the instruction to cite nothing.
States it cannot purchase or issue tickets; turn 2 'there is no confirmation number'; no payment data requested.
